chapters.summary: Council staff welcomes attendees to the Bronx Delegation meeting, announces that no one may approach the dais during the vote, asks attendees to silence electronic devices, and invites the chair to begin.
chapters.title: Bronx Delegation opens hearing and announces dais and device rules

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Good afternoon everyone and welcome to Bronx delegation of the New York City Council.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: At this time during today's vote, no one may approach the dais.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Please silence any electronic devices you may have.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Chair, you may begin.

chapters.summary: Councilmember Amanda C. Farías welcomes attendees and identifies herself as co-chair with Councilmember Justin Sanchez. She acknowledges present members Aldebol, Dinowitz, Encarnación, Feliz, Riley, Stevens, and virtual Councilmember Pierina Sanchez.
chapters.title: Co-Chair Farías convenes Bronx Delegation and acknowledges members

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: Welcome to today's meeting of the Bronx delegation.

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: I'm Councilmember Amanda Farias, and I'm honored to co-chair the delegation with Councilmember Justin Sanchez.

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: I'd like to acknowledge the other members of the delegation who are present, Councilmembers Aldeball, Dinowitz, Encarnacion, Feliz, Riley, Stevens, and Councilmember Pierina Sanchez, who is virtual.

chapters.summary: Farías says the public meeting is convened under Section 103 of the Public Officers Law. She explains the delegation will vote to recommend Nivardo Lopez for mayoral appointment to the Taxi and Limousine Commission, subject to full Council advice and consent.
chapters.title: Farías states Public Officers Law authority and TLC nomination purpose

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: This public meeting of the delegation is convened pursuant to Section 103 of the Public Officers Law to conduct the following business.

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: Pursuant to Section 2301 of the New York City Charter, we will vote to recommend Novardo Lopez for appointment by the mayor to the New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission.

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: If nominated by the mayor, Mr.

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: Lopez's appointment will be subject to the advice and consent of the full council.

chapters.summary: Farías invites colleagues to make statements on the nomination. After asking for hands on Zoom and seeing none, she directs the clerk to call the roll.
chapters.title: Farías invites statements before TLC vote; none offered

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: Before we vote, I will invite my colleagues to offer any statements on the nomination before us.

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: Do any members have any statements they would like to put forward?

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: Are there any hands raised on the Zoom?

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: Seeing none, if there are no members of the delegation who wish to speak, I'll now ask the clerk to call the roll.

chapters.summary: Committee clerk Matthew DiStefano opens the roll call on Nivardo Lopez for the TLC. Co-Chairs Farías and Justin Sanchez vote aye, and Aldebol is called and recorded aye.
chapters.title: Clerk opens roll call on Nivardo Lopez TLC recommendation

utterances.speaker: Matthew DiStefano
utterances.text: Matthew DiStefano, committee clerk, Bronx delegation of the New York City Council.

utterances.speaker: Matthew DiStefano
utterances.text: In regards to Nevardo Lopez, TLC, co-chair Farias.

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: Aye.

utterances.speaker: Matthew DiStefano
utterances.text: Co-chair Justin Sanchez.

utterances.speaker: Matthew DiStefano
utterances.text: Aye.

utterances.speaker: Matthew DiStefano
utterances.text: Aldebar.

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: Aye.

chapters.summary: Councilmember Eric Dinowitz is called and votes aye. He praises Lopez as a friend who served the City Council and city and state Departments of Transportation, saying he will be an excellent fit for the role.
chapters.title: Dinowitz votes aye, praising Lopez's service to city and state

utterances.speaker: Matthew DiStefano
utterances.text: Dinowitz.

utterances.speaker: Eric Dinowitz
utterances.text: Very proudly voting aye for not just a friend, but someone who spent years serving our city in various ways, including this city council, including our city and state's Department of Transportation.

utterances.speaker: Eric Dinowitz
utterances.text: Someone who's going to be an excellent fit for this role.

utterances.speaker: Eric Dinowitz
utterances.text: I'm proudly voting aye for Novardo.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: All right.

chapters.summary: The clerk records Feliz and Riley as aye. When Pierina Sanchez is called, she asks permission to explain her vote and then praises Lopez's transportation expertise, experience with the governor, Gateway Development Corporation, and NYC DOT, and says he understands the Bronx; she votes aye.
chapters.title: Roll call continues; Pierina Sanchez explains aye for Lopez

utterances.speaker: Matthew DiStefano
utterances.text: Feliz.

utterances.speaker: Matthew DiStefano
utterances.text: I.

utterances.speaker: Matthew DiStefano
utterances.text: Riley.

utterances.speaker: Matthew DiStefano
utterances.text: I.

utterances.speaker: Matthew DiStefano
utterances.text: Irina Sanchez.

utterances.speaker: Pierina Ana Sanchez
utterances.text: Permission to explain my vote?

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Permission granted.

utterances.speaker: Pierina Ana Sanchez
utterances.text: Thank you, Chair.

utterances.speaker: Pierina Ana Sanchez
utterances.text: I just want to congratulate Nevada Lopez, who is an incredible professional, a transportation expert who brings so much to the table.

utterances.speaker: Pierina Ana Sanchez
utterances.text: I cannot imagine the Bronx sending anyone better to the TLC from his time serving as a secretary to the governor on transportation matters, to his time at the Gateway Development Corporation, to his time at the Department of Transportation here in the city.

utterances.speaker: Pierina Ana Sanchez
utterances.text: He is really someone who truly understands the Bronx, but also truly understands transportation policy and what we need.

utterances.speaker: Pierina Ana Sanchez
utterances.text: So proud to have you on the TLC.

utterances.speaker: Pierina Ana Sanchez
utterances.text: Congratulations.

utterances.speaker: Pierina Ana Sanchez
utterances.text: Thank you, colleagues, for supporting Navarro's nomination.

utterances.speaker: Pierina Ana Sanchez
utterances.text: I vote aye.

chapters.summary: After Stevens is called, clerk Matthew DiStefano announces the appointment has been approved by a vote of 8 affirmative, 0 negative, and no abstentions.
chapters.title: Roll call closes with 8-0 vote approving Lopez recommendation

utterances.speaker: Matthew DiStefano
utterances.text: Stevens.

utterances.speaker: Matthew DiStefano
utterances.text: By a vote of 8 in the affirmative, 0 in the negative, and no abstention, the appointment has been approved.

chapters.summary: Farías thanks members and says she will hold the vote open temporarily for a member to join. She adjourns everyone else and thanks them.
chapters.title: Farías holds vote open for late member and adjourns others

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: I'm going to hold the vote open temporarily for our member to join in.

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: Everyone else is adjourned.

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: Thank you all.

chapters.summary: After the break, Council staff announces a continuation. Clerk Matthew DiStefano resumes the Bronx Delegation roll call and calls Council Member Stevens; an aye is recorded.
chapters.title: Delegation resumes roll call for Council Member Stevens

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Continuation.

utterances.speaker: Matthew DiStefano
utterances.text: Roll call vote, Bronx delegation of the New York City Council.

utterances.speaker: Matthew DiStefano
utterances.text: Council member Stevens.

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: Aye.

chapters.summary: DiStefano announces the vote now stands at nine affirmative, zero negative, and no abstentions in favor of the appointment. He thanks the delegation.
chapters.title: Final vote stands 9-0 approving Lopez TLC recommendation

utterances.speaker: Matthew DiStefano
utterances.text: The vote now stands at nine any affirmative, zero any negative, and no abstentions in favor of the appointment.

utterances.speaker: Matthew DiStefano
utterances.text: Thank you.

chapters.summary: Farías thanks the delegation, congratulates Nivardo Lopez, and declares the hearing adjourned.
chapters.title: Farías congratulates Nivardo Lopez and adjourns hearing

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: Thank you so much, and congratulations to Novato Lopez.

utterances.speaker: Amanda C. Farías
utterances.text: This hearing is now adjourned.

summary: The Bronx Delegation of the New York City Council held a public hearing and vote on recommending Nivardo Lopez for appointment to the Taxi and Limousine Commission.
Co-Chairs Amanda C. Farías and Justin Sanchez presided; Councilmembers Eric Dinowitz and Pierina Sanchez spoke in support, citing Lopez's transportation and government experience.
The delegation initially approved the recommendation 8-0, held the vote open for a late member, then finalized it 9-0 and adjourned.
title: Bronx Delegation of the New York City Council
topic: Pursuant to Section 2301 of the New York City Charter, Recommendation to the Mayor by the Council Members representing the Borough of the Bronx of Nivardo Lopez to serve as a member of the Taxi and Limousine Commission
